messages:
Kai L: Hey — seeing the 'New Hire Orientation' event on my calendar at 9am PST but when I click the Zoom link it asks for a passcode. The calendar entry doesn't show one. Anyone else hit this? I'm in IST so worried about missing it. @Anita M
Anita M: Ugh thanks for flagging, Kai. We changed the meeting security after the invites went out which caused a mismatch. I removed the passcode requirement and re-synced the event. Please refresh your calendar (or re-import the ICS). Sorry for the churn :sweat_smile:
Devex Bot: Pushed updated ICS: https://redwood.internal/ics/onboarding/1793547790. New ICS includes explicit timezone info and a link without a passcode param. If you still see a passcode prompt, use the fallback join flow below.
Samir (IT): Short workaround if Zoom still prompts: open Zoom -> Join a Meeting -> enter Meeting ID 987 6543 210 and Passcode 0246. We cleared the passcode requirement on the scheduled meeting but some clients cache settings. We'll revoke the passcode after the session.
Lucy N: I'm on CET and my calendar showed PDT for the event earlier — is the calendar timezone sticky? Also where will the recording end up? I can't watch live at that time.
Anita M: Recording will be uploaded to Drive (onboarding recordings folder) and linked in #new-hires. Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/onboarding/recordings — permissions set to the @new-hires group. For the timezone: go to your calendar settings -> Time zone, set to your local. We pushed an ICS with explicit TZ strings which should fix client mis-labeling. If you still get duplicate invites, delete the old event and import the new ICS.
Devex Bot: ICS re-pushed at 1793547860. If you prefer not to re-import, accept the invite where organizer is "People Ops" and decline the duplicate. For quick join, fallback URL: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210 (no passcode param).
Kai L: Joined via meeting ID, worked fine. Recording link appears to be accessible now. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
Anita M: Thanks for the quick reports. Follow-up: I'll email a short how-to (add ICS, fix TZ, re-import) and keep the Drive recording pinned in #new-hires after the session. Ping me if anyone still can't get in.
